message: The required pre-materialization XLSX guard has no specified total-uncompressed-byte or ZIP-entry ceilings; please resolve the numeric limits before implementation.

notes: Settled: total uncompressed bytes <= 256 MB and ZIP entry count <= 256, enforced WHILE reading the archive so an over-limit file is rejected BEFORE full materialization (paired with the existing 15 MB compressed cap + 25,000-row cap). Generous for a legit SAP report (639KB compressed -> a few MB uncompressed, ~15 entries) yet blocks zip-bombs and entry-count bombs. Proceed with those constants.
